_meta: Owner: lead architect. Priority and milestone for every screen in design-handoff/screens.json. P0 = launch blocker, P1 = launch if on time, P2 = after launch, phase2 = AI phase, ref = reference only. Regenerate SCOPE.md and qa/release/screen-requirements.csv with `node scripts/plan/generate.mjs` after editing.

01.notes: First onboarding screen; next is 05 (D50 order 01 → 05 → 07 → 02 → 03 → 04 → 06 → T1 → N → L → P2 → P3 → sign-in). Returning users skip onboarding (D40)

05.notes: Right after 01 (D50); 2×2 illustrated stage tiles; quiz 1/4. Kept on the device until sign-in, then synced (questionnaire version 2)

07.notes: Right after 05 (D50), quiz 2/4, so later copy (02, 03, T1, P2, P3) uses the partner's name. Partner name pre-fills invite copy

02.notes: After 07 (D50). Four versions picked by the stage on 05: Dating, Living together (default), Engaged or married, Long-distance, each with its own bubbles; body names the partner. Bubbles pop in once

03.notes: "When did you last learn something new about <partner>?" (D50): 3 big options, private, quiz 3/4; kept on the device until sign-in

04.notes: Payoff (D50): the revealed-answer cards of 21 with an everyday example question (not the day-1 question), two answer cards and reaction pills

06.notes: Goal chips after 04 (D50), quiz 4/4; next is T1. Key dates (47) are not part of onboarding (PO 2026-11-11)

P2.notes: Bar chart 86% / 33% and findings with source lines (Gottman & Driver; Aron et al. 1997; Gable et al. 2004/2006); "Bonded turns this into 3 minutes a day for <names>, at <time>". Figures and sources checked against the original papers before launch (LEAD-13); no invented numbers

P3.notes: Business-critical (D50). Only the person who starts the couple; joiners by invite never see it (D29). × opens exit sheet 17 once, then sign-in on the free plan. Yearly pre-selected with per-person monthly price and yearly total, monthly "No free trial", Today / Day 5 / Day 7 timeline, "Try 7 days free". Purchase before sign-in under the anonymous RevenueCat id, moved by logIn(uid); premium only from the webhook. All prices and the save % from RevenueCat, never hard-coded; no ratings, reviews or user counts

10.notes: Share sheet with deep link. Share link carries the invite token `?t=` (D02)

14.notes: Day-3 gift (D52): once per couple, to both partners, when the couple earns its first 3-day streak badge on the free plan and never subscribed or used an introductory offer; replaces badge sheet 52b for that badge. Server decides eligibility. Never after the P3 trial

15.notes: Coupon (D52): 25% off the first year (RevenueCat offering day3), real 12-hour countdown from the server expires_at that starts when the gift is first opened; "Not now" closes (no 17); Today chip and Settings/Us Premium row while live; one offer_ending push 2 h before the end; no extensions. Prices from RevenueCat

16.notes: P3 design without a trial (D52); never shown automatically, opens only from a Premium touchpoint (D50). Closing opens 17. Prices from RevenueCat, one plan covers both

17.notes: Free / Premium table (D51), rows only for shipped features (D27). Main button "Try Premium free for 7 days" only while trial-eligible, else "Get Premium" (D52). From P3 it opens once, then "Continue with free" → sign-in (D50). D55: row "History: Last 2 days / Everything" only when shipped (EXPO_PUBLIC_SHIP_PREMIUM_HISTORY)

19.notes: D56: answers only on the question day (couple-local, 15-min grace on the DB clock); after that DAY_ENDED, draft kept, no paywall

22.notes: D55: a free couple reads the thread only for today and yesterday; older days locked (22-locked, unlock → paywall from=history)

29.notes: D55: from history_days; free couple sees answers only for today and yesterday, older days locked → paywall from=history. D56: missed days show "Only {name} answered" or missed, no answer entry

30.notes: D55: locked for a free couple when older than yesterday (30-locked, 30-unlock-cta). D56: no answer or edit on a past day

31.notes: Sunday push links here. Weekly aggregate; free recap shows days together only (D21)

32.notes: Locks float; pack icons static. No Spicy · 18+ pack at launch (D33)

33.notes: No free pack question (D51): a free couple reads "A question from this pack" as a sample; start_pack_question raises PREMIUM_REQUIRED unless Premium. Pack questions started under D43 stay answerable

34.notes: Same rows as 17, no trial (D52): "Save [X]%", "Get Premium for both"; prices from RevenueCat. D55: same History row as 17, only when shipped

36.notes: Retired by D52: no win-back screen ships; the only offer is the day-3 gift (14, 15) with the Today chip. Release check: the /winback route does not exist

38.notes: Tapping opens Today. Never shows the partner's answer before I answered (FUN-04, D26). No answer text in the widget timeline data

38b.notes: Countdown + Partner answered small widgets (D47). Tapping opens Today. Never shows the partner's answer (FUN-04); no answer text in the widget timeline data

41.notes: D48: the Little things sounds switch also silences little-thing pushes (server pref)

42.notes: D08: ended-couple note shows the real end date

47.notes: Not in onboarding (PO 2026-11-11): onboarding goes 06 → T1 directly; key dates are added only from the Us tab (with milestones 48–51). Optional, skippable. Partner adds own birthday

55.notes: D56: a queued answer counts only if it reaches the DB within the day + 15 min; else DAY_ENDED, kept as a draft, no paywall

58.notes: D08: ended-couple note with the real date. D55: the ended archive and PDF show only unlocked days; locked days counted in the PDF
